name: manual_e01c31
claim: A pre-commit hook rejection means no commit exists, and a push after it publishes the old head. Check git log -1 after every commit, never background a commit whose hook output you need to see, and stage named files rather than git add -A, because add -A staged a generated __pycache__ file that the hygiene gate then rejected. Verify branch-ahead counts with git log against the remote branch, not from memory.
conditions: pre-commit hook rejected commit push empty branch git add pycache

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: a lint failure blocked a commit while I pushed, which published an empty branch; a backgrounded commit failed unseen and left changes staged; a tracked pycache file failed repo hygiene. Re-committing after fixing lint and cleaning pycache landed each commit.
